claims.text: The Equinox was originally established in 1769 as Marsh Tavern, Vermont's oldest hotel and a gathering place for Ethan Allen's Green Mountain Boys.

findings.quote: Originally established in 1769 as Marsh Tavern, Vermont’s oldest hotel and a gathering place for Ethan Allen’s Green Mountain Boys

claims.text: The resort is set in the heart of Manchester, Vermont, and is a four-season destination.

findings.quote: Set in the heart of Manchester, Vermont, The Equinox Golf Resort & Spa is a historic four- season destination

claims.text: The resort is surrounded by the Green Mountains and has a championship golf course, a full-service spa and year-round outdoor activities.

findings.quote: Surrounded by the scenic Green Mountains, the resort features elegant accommodations, a championship golf course, a full-service spa, and year-round outdoor activities.

claims.text: Guests have unlimited access to 850 acres of private hiking trails at the Equinox Preservation Trust.

findings.quote: Unlimited access to 850 acres of private hiking trails at the Equinox Preservation Trust.

claims.text: The Charles Orvis Inn is a 19th-century building adjacent to the Main Inn, with a library, a fireplace sitting room and a New England-style porch.

findings.quote: Charles Orvis Inn, a 19th-century gem located adjacent to the Main Inn
a cozy library, a fireplace sitting room, a New England-style porch

claims.text: Orvis Inn suites have a living room with a fireplace, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen and a marble bath.

findings.quote: a gracious living room with a fireplace and sleeper sofa, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a beautiful marble bath with a tub and shower.

claims.text: The Dormy House is a bi-level private home overlooking the first tee of the golf course.

findings.quote: Overlooking the first tee of the golf course, The Dormy House is a spacious, bi-level retreat
This free-standing private home

claims.text: The Spa at The Equinox has a sauna and steam room, a 24-hour fitness and yoga studio, an indoor lap pool and an outdoor whirlpool.

findings.quote: a sauna and steam room, a 24-hour fitness and yoga studio, a 25-yard indoor lap pool, and a beautiful outdoor whirlpool

claims.text: The spa holds Sound Bath sessions that combine water, sound and stillness in the spa pool.

findings.quote: the Sound Bath, a soothing fusion of water, sound, and stillness in the serene setting of our spa pool

claims.text: The Land Rover Experience at The Equinox teaches expedition-style off-road driving over obstacles such as steep inclines and rock crawls.

findings.quote: Elevate your off-road skills with Land Rover Experience at The Equinox. Learn expedition-style driving and conquer thrilling obstacles like steep inclines, rock crawls, and more.

claims.text: The resort fee includes resort bikes for riding in town or on trails, plus sleds and children's snowshoes for winter.

findings.quote: EQUINOX RESORT FEE INCLUSIONS
Access to resort bikes for in town or trail riding.
Sleds & Kids Monster Trax Snow Shoes for winter fun.

claims.text: Falcon Bar's seating area offers Green Mountain views through original windows.

findings.quote: the charming seating area of Falcon bar offering expansive Green Mountain views through original windows

claims.text: The bi-level Cupola Suite in the Main Inn has a king bedroom, a separate upstairs living room and 360-degree mountain views from its cupola.

findings.quote: The bi-level one-bedroom Cupola Suite features a king bedroom, a separate living room upstairs with queen sleeper sofa, and 360 degree mountain views in this unique cupola.

findings.quote: A luxurious, bi-level, one-bedroom suite overlooking the mountains, Green Mountain Suite features a king bedroom, a separate living room with a queen sleeper sofa and a dining area.
